affected_publication.historical_record_authority: The original closeout remains authoritative evidence of what commit af08d963a5fc1a86b2df643072e49341dfa62b67 published.
affected_publication.historical_record_treatment: This correction does not rewrite or replace the historical closeout. The historical closeout is excluded from the corrective publication boundary and must remain byte-identical to the version in the affected commit.

correction.finding: Synthetic inputs for six WDI families were assigned unrelated historical provider artifact paths and SHA-256 digests instead of provenance for the exact supplied synthetic bytes. A subsequent bounded review also found that nested raw_artifacts paired the enclosing bundle path with response-level byte counts and digests, conflating two physical artifact identities.
correction.supersession_scope: This record supersedes only the defective synthetic-input provenance and associated reproducibility claims. It does not supersede the original publication as a historical event or withdraw unrelated valid evidence from that publication.
corrected_behavior: raw_artifact_path identifies the actual supplied enclosing input bundle
raw_sha256 is derived from the exact supplied bundle bytes decoded into normalized input
nested raw_artifacts raw_file, bytes, and sha256 identify that same supplied bundle and its exact bytes
nested raw_artifacts response_bytes and response_sha256 separately identify each exact canonicalized response representation
missing or contradictory required provenance fails closed
historical provider inputs retain their actual historical provenance
truthful provenance propagates through affected package, loader, release, refresh, and foundational-bundle metadata

deliberately_excluded_paths.reason: The file was already untracked before this correction, and complete whole-file publication ownership is unresolved. Its local working-tree content is not part of this corrective lifecycle unit.
The original historical closeout is preserved unchanged; correction is represented additively by this record.

rights_and_reproducibility.provider_payload_rights_effect: No provider payload was added, copied, or redistributed by the defect or this authored correction. Existing provider evidence remains local and excluded from this corrective boundary.
rights_and_reproducibility.reproducibility_statement: The authored synthetic evidence and corrective implementation are deterministic. Exact historical provider replay, production PostgreSQL regeneration, and full historical-run reproduction are not claimed.

verification_evidence.nested_artifact_red: An isolated export of committed c17fda8c30f09695eee1697088ba022055c8077c collected six independently named family cases; all six failed because committed production did not accept explicit raw_artifact_path and raw_payload provenance and therefore could not satisfy the bundle/response identity contract.
verification_evidence.nested_artifact_green: A separate isolated clean export overlaid with exactly the 15 technical candidate paths passed all six independently named nested-artifact regression cases.
verification_evidence.current_positive_assessed_surface: The exact positive 22-file assessed surface collected 132 tests and passed all 132. The earlier historical 112-test result is not claimed as the current result because the corrected surface now includes 20 additional provenance cases.
verification_evidence.synthetic_serialization: tests/synthetic_wdi.py owns canonical serialized bytes and SHA-256 identities; tests/test_synthetic_wdi.py proves repeated byte and digest determinism
verification_evidence.scope_limit: These results support the working-tree correction but do not establish publication. Publication readiness additionally requires the exact declared boundary and its clean-export and preservation gates to pass.

publication_status.durability_rule: This corrective record and its technical correction become durable only through a subsequent publication containing exactly the 16 declared Git-durable paths.
